_doc: Corner order A-D per board, for registering the board from 4 PCB corners (board.mjs) and for the brain prompt (brain.mjs). corners: [x_mm, y_mm] in the part file's frame (x right, y DOWN from the top-left of outline_mm). A -> B -> C -> D runs clockwise seen from above, components up, so naming A and B fixes C and D. edges: which feature sits on which edge of the drawing. header: how the pins stand (female 8.5 mm sockets, male pins up, or male pins down into a breadboard), the height in mm above the PCB top where a jumper meets the pin (z), and whether a pin looks dark (a socket hole) or bright (a metal pin / solder joint) on camera. pinNames: how the brain should name pins. Written for Ody; physical facts of each board, no third-party text.

arduino-mega-2560.look: Arduino Mega 2560: long blue board, USB-B + barrel jack on a short edge, extra double header (22-53) at the far end
arduino-mega-2560.cornerA: where the USB-B edge meets the digital-header edge (pins 0-21)
arduino-mega-2560.cornerB: the other end of that edge, at the double header (22-53)
arduino-mega-2560.cornerC: far end of the power/analog edge (A15)
arduino-mega-2560.cornerD: USB/barrel-jack edge x power-header edge, by the barrel jack

arduino-nano.look: Arduino Nano: small 43 x 18 mm stick, mini-USB at one end, 2 x 15 pins along the long edges, ICSP at the other end
arduino-nano.cornerA: USB end x the long edge with D12 ... D2, GND, RST, RX0, TX1
arduino-nano.cornerB: the ICSP end of that edge (TX1 / D1)
arduino-nano.cornerC: ICSP end of the other long edge (VIN)
arduino-nano.cornerD: USB end x the edge with D13, 3V3, AREF, A0-A7 (by D13)

edges.bottom: D13, 3.3V, AREF, A0-A7, 5V, RESET, GND, VIN

esp32-devkit-v1.look: ESP32 DevKit V1 (30 pins): black stick, silver shielded ESP-WROOM-32 module with a PCB antenna at one end, micro-USB + EN/BOOT buttons at the other
esp32-devkit-v1.cornerA: antenna end x the pin column starting EN, VP, VN
esp32-devkit-v1.cornerB: antenna end x the column starting D23, D22, TX0
esp32-devkit-v1.cornerD: USB end of the EN column (VIN)

edges.left: EN, VP, VN, D34 ... D13, GND, VIN

esp32-devkitc.look: ESP32-DevKitC (38 pins): like the DevKit V1 but 2 x 19 pins, pins printed as bare numbers (0, 2, 4 ... 35)
esp32-devkitc.cornerA: antenna end x the column starting 3V3, EN, VP
esp32-devkitc.cornerB: antenna end x the column starting GND, 23, 22

raspberry-pi-pico.look: Raspberry Pi Pico: green 21 x 51 mm stick, micro-USB at one end, RP2040 chip in the middle, castellated 2 x 20 pins
raspberry-pi-pico.cornerA: USB end x the GP0 column (pin 1)
raspberry-pi-pico.cornerB: USB end x the VBUS column (pin 40)
raspberry-pi-pico.cornerC: far (debug pads) end of the VBUS column (GP16, pin 21)
raspberry-pi-pico.cornerD: far end of the GP0 column (GP15, pin 20)

raspberry-pi-pico-w.look: Raspberry Pi Pico W: a Pico with a silver Wi-Fi can and antenna at the far end from USB
raspberry-pi-pico-w.cornerA: USB end x the GP0 column (pin 1)
raspberry-pi-pico-w.cornerB: USB end x the VBUS column (pin 40)
raspberry-pi-pico-w.cornerC: antenna end of the VBUS column (GP16, pin 21)
raspberry-pi-pico-w.cornerD: antenna end of the GP0 column (GP15, pin 20)

edges.bottom: Wi-Fi can and antenna, debug pads

raspberry-pi-4.look: Raspberry Pi 3/4/5: credit-card 85 x 56 mm board, 40-pin GPIO along one long edge, USB/Ethernet on a short edge
raspberry-pi-4.cornerA: GPIO-edge corner at pin 1 (the end away from USB/Ethernet)
raspberry-pi-4.cornerB: GPIO-edge corner at the USB/Ethernet end
raspberry-pi-4.cornerC: USB/Ethernet edge x the edge with USB-C power, micro-HDMI and audio
raspberry-pi-4.cornerD: that edge's other end, by the USB-C power port (microSD edge)

edges.top: 2x20 GPIO header (pin 1 at the left, inner row odd pins)

nodemcu-esp8266.look: NodeMCU ESP8266: black or blue stick, silver ESP-12 module with antenna at one end, micro-USB + RST/FLASH buttons at the other, pins D0-D8
nodemcu-esp8266.cornerA: antenna end x the A0, RSV, SD3 column
nodemcu-esp8266.cornerB: antenna end x the D0, D1, D2 column
nodemcu-esp8266.cornerD: USB end of the A0 column (VIN)

edges.left: A0, RSV, SD3 ... RST, GND, VIN
